rows.check: average: the page clearly prints 28 (checked at 450 dpi; OCR agrees), but it is implausible: Round -> Skinless Fillet 35 over Round -> D/H-Off 68 implies about 51, and D/H-Off (Eastern) -> Skinless Fillet is 56. Probably an error in the source; transcribed as printed.

to: the page clearly prints 'Salted D/H-Off' (OCR agrees). Every other salmon table has 'Mild Cure Sides' in this position, and 47 is what Mild Cure Sides would be here (Round -> Mild Cure Sides 35 over Round -> D/H-Off 74). Probably a mislabel in the source; transcribed as printed.

average: the page clearly prints 55 (OCR agrees). In every other salmon table Smoked Sides equals the Mild Cure Sides figure in the same From group, which would give about 47 here. Possibly an error in the source; transcribed as printed.

range: the page clearly prints 13-28 (checked at 450 dpi; OCR agrees). The same row for the other salmon is 13-19, 13-19, 13-18 and 13-20, so the high end may be an error in the source; transcribed as printed.

rows.check: To cell: the page clearly prints 'Cooked Peeled' with average 69, but 69 is implausible for that product (Raw Whole -> Cooked Peeled 25 over Raw Whole -> Raw Headless 53 is about 47, while Raw Peeled 36 over 53 is about 68, and the parallel row under Spot is 'Raw Headless -> Raw Peeled 72'). Probably a misprint in the bulletin for 'Raw Peeled'; transcribed as printed, not changed.

To cell: the page clearly prints 'Kurimi' (average 48 is also clear). 'Kurimi' is not a product term I know; it may be a misprint for 'Kirimi' (a Japanese-market headed, gutted, tail-off cut), which would explain why 48 is far above Skinless Fillet 25 in the same Round group. Transcribed as printed, not changed.

notes.text: Freezing conditions and length of storage will affect recoveries. Poor conditions and storage more than six months will reduce yields significantly.
